thread:
ashley: Quick perf note — I ran FP8 kernels on qwen-220B with our 4k sequence distribution. Latency p95 down ~18% but our long-form calibration eval perplexity increased ~5%.

mike: Any chance the calib set changed? small sample bias can blow FP8.

ashley: Same calib set as last week (qa-longform-v3). I re-ran twice. Throughput up ~22% though.

benchbot: perf summary:
```
model: qwen-220b
kernel: fp8-optimized
batch: 8
seq: 2048
p95_latency_ms: 380  # baseline (int8/4bit) was 460
throughput_tok_s: 1.22e6
calib_eval_delta_ppl: +5.1%
```

devin: Interesting — did you enable kv_calib? FP8 interacts with KV cache perf/precision a lot.

ashley: Yes, kv_calib=true in the run. I also tried disabling kv_calib and the latency is a little better but the quality delta is the same.

rio: Posting a small quant_profile I used for Llama that seemed stable — maybe adapt it for Qwen. I think the main knobs are calibrator choice and layers to keep in fp32:
```
quant_profile:
  model_family: qwen
  dtype: fp8
  calibrator: mixed_histogram
  calib_samples: 1024
  kv_calib: true
  fp32_layers: [0,1,2]
  per_channel: true
```

mike: FYI we saw FP8 regressions on code-heavy tokens for Llama2 when calibrator was pure histogram. mixed_histogram + per_channel reduced that.

devin: Could be that our current calibration set underrepresents code tokens and long-context repeat patterns. Suggest: (1) add 500 long-code examples to qa-longform-v3, (2) run a small grid for calibrator={histogram,mixed_histogram,kl} and fp32_layers={0..4}.

ashley: I'll kick off the grid this afternoon. Can someone add a template profile to model-profiles repo? I'd like a standard naming: qwen-220b.fp8.mixed_histogram.yaml.

mike: I'll open the PR and include the perf artifacts + the tiny eval harness.

benchbot: queued job: /bench/qwen-fp8-grid-176900 - 12 variants, estimate 4h. Will post logs to the thread when done.

rio: Also note batching heuristics: for FP8 the optimal batch boundary changed. We should add an automated microbenchmark that tests batch sizes 1..16 with seq 512/2048 to recommend batching policy per profile.

ashley: Good call. Adding to action items. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

mike: action items: PR model profile, add microbench script; devin add samples to calib set; ashley run grid and post results.

ashley: Will update here after the grid. If FP8 still regresses we'll try an int8 fallback on the last N layers and compare.

benchbot: job started. logs -> /artifacts/1769001234/qwen-fp8-grid

mike: Thanks — let's aim to have a recommendation (fp8 vs int8 vs hybrid) for config sharing next week.
